What is the difference between a maxi cab and a minibus?

The key difference lies in capacity and service type. A maxi cab in Sydney typically carries up to 11 passengers and operates as a taxi for direct point-to-point travel, including airport transfers and group outings. A minibus is a larger vehicle, usually seating 12 or more people, and is generally hired for charter services like tours or specific event transport on a pre-defined route and schedule. A maxi cab offers greater flexibility for on-demand group travel.
